title: Was the Stranger Things ending FAKE? | Conformity Gate Part 1

shots.vo: New Year's Eve, 2025. Stranger Things ended after nine years. The kids grew up. Everyone got their happy ending.
shots.prompt: A dark 1980s living room at night, wood-panel walls, a boxy CRT television glowing cold blue with static, an empty armchair facing it, slow push-in toward the screen, dust floating in the air

shots.vo: And within days, thousands of fans decided... none of it was real. They believed the finale was an illusion created by Vecna, and that a secret Episode 9 was coming.
shots.prompt: A sunny, too-perfect 1980s suburban street with identical pastel houses and trimmed lawns, the image slowly flickering and glitching like a broken VHS tape, slow lateral tracking shot

shots.vo: They called it the Conformity Gate. And the clues they found... were strange.
shots.prompt: A rusted wrought-iron gate standing alone in a foggy pine forest at night, deep red light glowing behind it, the gate slowly creaks open a few inches, locked-off wide shot

caption: Stranger Things ended on New Year's Eve... so why did fans think it wasn't over? Part 2 tomorrow.
